title: U.S.-Iran Talks End With No Deal; How Will Dow Jones Futures, Oil Prices React?
title_zh: 美国与伊朗谈判未达成协议；道琼斯期货、油价将如何反应？
summary: Futures loom after lengthy U.S.-Iran talks ended without an agreement. Vice President J.D. Vance said Tehran has "chosen not to accept our terms."
summary_zh: 在美国与伊朗漫长的谈判没有达成协议的情况下结束后，期货前景黯淡。副总统万斯表示，德黑兰“选择不接受我们的条件”。

title: Walmart Gemini AI Deal Strengthens Platform Thesis And Valuation Debate
title_zh: 沃尔玛 Gemini 人工智能交易强化了平台论点和估值辩论
summary: Walmart (NasdaqGS:WMT) is expanding its partnership with Google to integrate Gemini AI into its shopping app for instant checkout and more personalized customer experiences.
summary_zh: 沃尔玛（NasdaqGS：WMT）正在扩大与谷歌的合作伙伴关系，将 Gemini AI 集成到其购物应用程序中，以实现即时结账和更个性化的客户体验。

title: KKR Balances Credit Fund Redemptions With PolyPeptide Deal Ambitions
title_zh: KKR 平衡信贷基金赎回与多肽交易雄心
summary: KKR is facing a wave of investor redemption requests in its private credit funds, prompting withdrawal limits similar to those seen at other large asset managers.
summary_zh: KKR 的私人信贷基金正面临一波投资者赎回请求，这导致了与其他大型资产管理公司类似的提款限制。

title: SpaceX Is Going Public. Why a Tesla Merger Could Be Musk’s Real Endgame.
title_zh: SpaceX 即将上市。为什么特斯拉的合并可能是马斯克真正的结局。
summary: SpaceX’s initial public offering may be the largest IPO ever, but it might just be a prelude to the largest merger ever—a combination of  Tesla  with Elon Musk’s space venture. On April 1, SpaceX reportedly filed confidentially for an IPO.
summary_zh: SpaceX 的首次公开募股可能是有史以来最大规模的 IPO，但这可能只是有史以来最大的合并（特斯拉与埃隆·马斯克的太空企业合并）的前奏。据报道，4 月 1 日，SpaceX 秘密提交了 IPO 申请。

title: Microsoft Staff Tell Carbon Removal Projects That Deals Paused
title_zh: 微软员工告诉碳清除项目交易已暂停
